data.name: CoordinatorApprovalHelp
data.value: This immutable plan is waiting. CitusManager will not begin the metadata cutover until an Admin attests that the external physical failover is complete.

data.name: CoordinatorTargetUnknown
data.value: target endpoint in the immutable plan

data.name: CoordinatorFenceWarning
data.value: Complete every external step in order. CitusManager cannot verify the write fence or promote the physical standby.

data.name: CoordinatorFenceStep1
data.value: Quiesce all receiving endpoints: stop application writes, migrations, DDL, topology, backup, and administrative traffic across the cluster.

data.name: CoordinatorFenceStep2
data.value: Fence and stop source coordinator A. Verify it cannot accept writes or be automatically restarted as primary.

data.name: CoordinatorFenceStep3
data.value: Promote physical standby B externally at {0}; verify PostgreSQL is writable, Citus is loaded, and the expected database and timeline are active.

data.name: CoordinatorFenceStep4
data.value: Keep all receiving endpoints quiesced. Approve below, then wait for every CitusManager validation checkpoint before changing external routing or retiring A.

data.name: CoordinatorExternalRouting
data.value: CitusManager does not change DNS, load balancers, application connection pools, orchestrator roles, or PostgreSQL replication state.

data.name: CoordinatorFenceAck
data.value: I confirm all receiving endpoints are quiesced, source A is fenced/stopped, and physical standby B was promoted and verified externally.

data.name: CoordinatorConfirmationHelp
data.value: Approval immediately queues the Citus metadata and control-profile cutover.

data.name: CoordinatorAwaitingAdmin
data.value: An Admin must complete the external failover checklist and approve this migration.

data.name: AwaitingCoordinatorApprovalDetail
data.value: Plan created; waiting for external fence, physical standby promotion, and Admin approval.
